method: Six calls, paired old/new descriptions, three isolated versions of one saved display rule. One observation per cell, no automatic repairs. Narrow checker experiment, not an end-to-end extraction benchmark.
expected_complete: alternatives correct, unit covered, no error/unknown dimensions
expected_defects: alternatives error and unit partial; manually inspect rationale for the intended defect
controls: All evidence fields retain the complete source paragraph. logic_text empty in ALL three fixtures to isolate summary and choice_text and prevent a deliberate omission from surviving in another meaning field. Only summary and choice_text differ among fixtures. Original saved draft is preserved separately.
